entities.name: Core network selection
entities.description: Procedure performed by a UE supporting CIoT optimizations to select between EPC or 5GCN core network types based on various indications and UE capabilities.

entities.name: UE supports CIoT optimizations
entities.description: Condition that the UE must support CIoT optimizations to perform core network selection.

entities.name: E-UTRA cell connected to both EPC and 5GCN
entities.description: Condition where lower layers indicate the current E-UTRA cell is connected to both EPC and 5GCN.

entities.name: EPC core network type
entities.description: Selected EPC core network type based on selection criteria.

entities.name: 5GCN core network type
entities.description: Selected 5GCN core network type based on selection criteria.

entities.name: CIoT EPS optimizations supported by UE
entities.description: Information about CIoT EPS optimizations supported by the UE.

entities.name: CIoT 5GS optimizations supported by UE
entities.description: Information about CIoT 5GS optimizations supported by the UE.

entities.name: UE's preferred CIoT network behaviour for EPC
entities.description: UE's preferred CIoT network behaviour configuration for EPC.

entities.name: UE's preferred CIoT network behaviour for 5GCN
entities.description: UE's preferred CIoT network behaviour configuration for 5GCN.

entities.name: Initial registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which the UE provides the selected core network type information to the lower layer.

relations.description: Core network selection procedure requires that the UE supports CIoT optimizations.
Core network selection procedure requires that lower layers indicate dual connectivity to both EPC and 5GCN.
